# Tool registry

Deterministic, reusable tools. **Check here before writing a new script.** If a task repeats, turn it into a tool:
add `tools/<name>/index.ts` and `tools/<name>/tool.json`, then run `pnpm bd index`. Every tool runs as `pnpm bd <name> ...`.

| Tool | Purpose | Usage | Outputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `analytics` | Usage analytics (SHARING-0010) from the command line: run the private dashboard's fixed queries against an environment's Workers Analytics Engine dataset with the local query token, or print them (--sql). No custom SQL. | `pnpm bd analytics --env staging [--days 7]`<br>`pnpm bd analytics --env production --only daws,blocks`<br>`pnpm bd analytics --sql --env staging` | JSON {env, dataset, days, results{name: rows|error}} on stdout (or the SQL with --sql) |
| `audio` | Sounds-like-v1 check (SPEC-AUDIO-V1-PARITY): render each v1 audio fixture with the v2 WASM engine and compare level, pitch, spectrum, envelope and stereo descriptors with v1's own renders (from `bd v1 audio`); `selftest` proves it rejects audible changes. | `pnpm bd audio compare`<br>`pnpm bd audio compare --only fx-reverb --save`<br>`pnpm bd audio selftest` | JSON {checked, passed, knownFailures, failed, rows}; tests/audio/output/*.v2.wav with --save |
| `block-designer` | Internal design page for new block shapes (not part of the app): randomise and hand-edit shapes, fills and colours on v1's grid, preview them in all 13 themes beside every existing block, warn on look-alikes and colours that vanish, and copy manifest-ready geometry. Proposed designs live in tools/block-designer/proposed.json; `scaffold` writes a block manifest from one. | `pnpm bd block-designer`<br>`pnpm bd block-designer --open`<br>`pnpm bd block-designer scaffold "Compressor" --id fx.compressor --kind post-effect --catchment 6` | .cache/block-designer/index.html (a single offline page; loads polygon-clipping from jsDelivr for exact outlines); JSON {path, blocks, designed, themes} on stdout |
| `ci` | Run the CI jobs locally (GitHub Actions is manual-only to save minutes): docs/codegen checks, v1 pixel verify, web typecheck/build/smoke, engine dev/release/asan, golden renders, WASM≡native, plugin, iPad AUv3 in the Simulator. Optional Linux engine run in Docker. | `pnpm bd ci`<br>`pnpm bd ci --only engine,golden`<br>`pnpm bd ci --linux`<br>`pnpm bd ci --windows` | Per-step pass/fail/skip summary on stderr; JSON counts on stdout; non-zero exit on any failure |
| `codegen` | Validate block manifests (JSON Schema + naming/folder/uniqueness rules) and generate the engine C++ catalogue and web TS block/palette modules. `--check` fails on invalid manifests or stale generated files. | `pnpm bd codegen`<br>`pnpm bd codegen --check` | engine/include/blokdust/generated/blocks.gen.hpp, web/src/generated/blocks.gen.ts, web/src/generated/palettes.gen.ts; JSON summary on stdout |
| `gallery` | Review the public gallery (SPEC-SHARING-GALLERY): list reported or hidden patches with their reasons, then hide one, keep it (clear its reports) or remove it from the gallery. Manage the site's own @blokdust account (R16): publish the built-in presets as its EXAMPLES, hand it the sign-ins of an account made for it, and move its patches between EXAMPLES and TUTORIALS. Works on a deployed env's D1 or a local test state. | `pnpm bd gallery reports --env production`<br>`pnpm bd gallery hide <id> --env production`<br>`pnpm bd gallery keep <id> --env production`<br>`pnpm bd gallery remove <id> --local gallery`<br>`pnpm bd gallery presets --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd gallery official <name> --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd gallery kind <id> tutorial --env staging` | JSON on stdout: the reported patches, or what was done |
| `index` | Regenerate and validate the ADR, spec, change and tool indexes from frontmatter. `--check` fails on stale indexes or invalid frontmatter (use in CI and before committing docs). | `pnpm bd index`<br>`pnpm bd index --check` | docs/decisions/**/README.md, docs/specs/README.md, tools/README.md; JSON summary on stdout |
| `lint` | Every static check in one command (CHG-0045): tsc for web, server, tools/tests/shared and the glossary; Prettier; ESLint (typescript-eslint strict type-checked, no any); clang-format and clang-tidy (pinned LLVM in .cache, `setup`). ESLint and clang-tidy findings have baselines that may only shrink (`prune` lowers them). `--staged` checks what is staged (the pre-commit hook); `install` sets that hook (bd size + bd lint). | `pnpm bd lint`<br>`pnpm bd lint --staged`<br>`pnpm bd lint --only eslint --fix`<br>`pnpm bd lint setup`<br>`pnpm bd lint baseline`<br>`pnpm bd lint prune`<br>`pnpm bd lint install` | JSON {staged, outcomes{check: pass|fail|skip}, failed[]} on stdout; findings on stderr; exit 1 on any failure. Baselines: eslint-suppressions.json, tools/lint/clang-tidy-baseline.json |
| `new` | Scaffold an ADR, domain spec or change proposal from the templates, with the next free ID. | `pnpm bd new adr <domain> "Title"`<br>`pnpm bd new spec <domain> "Title"`<br>`pnpm bd new change "Title"` | New markdown file(s); JSON list of created paths on stdout |
| `patches` | Rewrite stored patches whose block settings changed shape (no load-time conversion; SPEC-PATCH-FORMAT-V2). CHG-0040: Random Note's key + scale + octaves become 12 weights + a semitone range; Chord's one chord becomes the same chord on all 12 notes, Smooth off. Works on patch files (and golden fixtures) or every revision in an env's D1, after exporting a backup. | `pnpm bd patches migrate --files tests/golden/random-note.json`<br>`pnpm bd patches migrate --env staging --dry-run`<br>`pnpm bd patches migrate --env production`<br>`pnpm bd patches migrate --local gallery` | JSON on stdout: what changed (files, or revisions with block counts) and the backup path; patch files rewritten in place; .cache/backups/<env>-<time>.sql |
| `perf` | Performance baselines: engine CPU per 128-frame buffer (native release + WASM) on generated voice/particle scenes, and the Pixi stage stress benchmark; writes .cache/perf/baselines.md. | `pnpm bd perf`<br>`pnpm bd perf --no-web` | JSON {machine, engine[], web[]}; .cache/perf/baselines.md; generated scenes in .cache/perf/ |
| `plugin` | Build the JUCE 8 plugin (VST3/AU/Standalone, WebView editor embedding web/dist), run pluginval (strictness 5), and load the built VST3 headlessly like a DAW: golden fixtures must hash exactly like the native engine and the editor must build the stage from the patch. `package` makes the notarised universal macOS installer (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg). `ios build|test` builds the iPadOS AUv3 inside the BlokDust app for the Simulator and loads it out of process like AUM: golden hashes ≡ native, state round-trip, editor bd_ready; and checks the app itself: output-only audio, no microphone entry, patch saved and restored (CHG-0025). `ios archive` makes the App Store build (the live site, distribution signing) and checks it: one version and build number, privacy manifests, encryption declared; it exports an .ipa, or with --upload sends it to App Store Connect. | `pnpm bd plugin build`<br>`pnpm bd plugin validate`<br>`pnpm bd plugin test`<br>`pnpm bd plugin ios test [--no-build]`<br>`pnpm bd plugin ios device [--no-build]`<br>`pnpm bd plugin ios log`<br>`pnpm bd plugin ios archive [--build N] [--upload]`<br>`pnpm bd plugin package`<br>`pnpm bd plugin deploy [--no-build] [--force]` | build/plugin/plugin/BlokDust_artefacts/Release/{VST3,AU,Standalone}; JSON {pluginval, renders}; build/plugin-ios-sim/…/Standalone/BlokDust.app (AUv3 inside); .cache/ios-host/{result.json,app.png,editor.png,editor-small.png}; .cache/ios-release/<version>-<build>/{BlokDust.xcarchive,BlokDust.ipa} |
| `privacy` | Check tracked files or all reachable history for private hosts, personal paths, emails, signing identities and credential patterns; report locations without matched values. Test external configuration and remote-config isolation. | `pnpm bd privacy check`<br>`pnpm bd privacy history`<br>`pnpm bd privacy selftest` | JSON counts and finding locations; no private values. Selftest runs isolated configuration and leak-detection tests. |
| `release` | Publish the plugin installers (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg and -Windows.exe from `bd plugin package` / `bd win package`) to downloads.funputs.com/releases/blokdust/<version>/ and write web/src/releases.json, which the web app's Settings › DOWNLOAD tab reads. Immutable: refuses a version already published. `tag` tags vX.Y.Z on main and publishes its GitHub release (docs/engineering/branches-and-releases.md); it deploys nothing. | `pnpm bd release check`<br>`pnpm bd release publish --dry-run`<br>`pnpm bd release publish`<br>`pnpm bd release tag [--dry-run] [--notes <file>]` | JSON summary on stdout; web/src/releases.json; objects in the funputs-releases R2 bucket |
| `render` | Offline-render a patch fixture with the native engine (WAV, event log, hashes, descriptors), and run golden tests: exact audio/event hashes for tests/golden/*.json, optionally across build configs. | `pnpm bd render tests/golden/emitter-tone.json --wav out.wav --events out.jsonl`<br>`pnpm bd render --check --configs release,dev`<br>`pnpm bd render --update` | JSON summary {audioHash, eventHash, events, rms, peak, ...}; tests/golden/expected/*.json on --update |
| `server` | The sharing backend (Cloudflare Worker + D1 in server/): run it locally on web/dist, create the D1 database and Turnstile widget for an environment, upload secrets, deploy, and run the sharing e2e suite against a deployed Worker. | `pnpm bd server dev [--real]`<br>`pnpm bd server setup --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd server config --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd server secret --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd server deploy --env staging`<br>`pnpm bd server smoke --env staging` | JSON summaries on stdout; local D1 state in .cache/server/; secrets only in ~/.config/blokdust and Cloudflare |
| `size` | Keep agent-written files small enough to read whole (owner, 2026-11-20): a file may hold about 5,000 tokens (UTF-8 bytes ÷ 4). Files already over it are listed in tools/size/baseline.json and may only shrink (a ratchet). The pre-commit hook checks the staged files. | `pnpm bd size check [--staged]`<br>`pnpm bd size baseline`<br>`pnpm bd size install` | JSON: files checked, files over the limit (new, or grown past their baseline), files now smaller than their baseline. Exit 1 when a file is over. |
| `ui` | Interactive v1 UI states as black-box references: replay the same pointer actions in v1 (capture) and in the real v2 app (diff), screenshot the settled state and pixel-diff (menus, options panels, settings, share, tooltip). | `pnpm bd ui capture`<br>`pnpm bd ui diff`<br>`pnpm bd ui diff --only menu-source --save-all` | tests/visual/reference/v1/ui/*.png + manifest.json (capture); JSON summary and tests/visual/output/ui/*.{v2,diff}.png (diff) |
| `v1` | Reference BlokDust v1 at a pinned commit: fetch/serve it, capture deterministic screenshots (with stage metrics) and audio (v1 on an OfflineAudioContext), extract draft block manifests + palettes from the running app, and verify manifests re-render v1's pixels. | `pnpm bd v1 fetch`<br>`pnpm bd v1 serve [port]`<br>`pnpm bd v1 capture tests/visual/fixtures/v1/*.json --blocks [--dpr 2] [--themes all] [--only name,...]`<br>`pnpm bd v1 audio [--only tone,fx-reverb]`<br>`pnpm bd v1 extract [--out blocks]`<br>`pnpm bd v1 verify [--dpr 1,2] [--only Laser,...] [--save-all]` | .cache/v1; tests/visual/reference/v1/*.png + manifest.json; tests/audio/reference/v1/*.wav + manifest.json; blocks/**/*.block.json drafts + blocks/v1-palettes.json; tests/visual/output/v1-verify/ (summary.json, v2/diff PNGs for failures) |
| `visual` | Render v1 reference compositions through the real v2 Stage (Pixi) and pixel-diff against v1 screenshots (region of blocks/overlays/lines); `bakeoff` scores the three block renderers (baked/msaa/ss2) on parity and frame time (UI-0005). | `pnpm bd visual diff --full`<br>`pnpm bd visual diff --renderer msaa --only proximity-chain --save-all`<br>`pnpm bd visual bakeoff` | JSON summary; tests/visual/output/v2-diff/*.png for failures; docs/engineering/renderer-bakeoff.md (bakeoff) |
| `wasm` | Install the pinned Emscripten (engine/emsdk-version), build the standalone engine WASM (no JS glue, zero imports), and prove WASM ≡ native: every golden fixture must hash identically in Node at 128- and 4096-frame blocks. | `pnpm bd wasm setup`<br>`pnpm bd wasm build`<br>`pnpm bd wasm test` | build/wasm/engine/blokdust.wasm, web/public/blokdust.wasm; JSON {fixtures, identical, wasmBytes} |
| `win` | Windows checks in the externally configured Windows ARM VM (QEMU; tools/win-vm): MSVC x64 engine build + tests + golden renders compared with macOS hashes; plugin build + pluginval + REAPER smoke test. `package` builds the Windows installer (Inno Setup, unsigned for Release 1), checks it installs and uninstalls, and zips it with a README.txt (BlokDust-<version>-Windows.zip). | `pnpm bd win engine`<br>`pnpm bd win plugin`<br>`pnpm bd win shot out.png`<br>`pnpm bd win package` | JSON summary; full logs in .cache/win-engine.log and .cache/win-plugin.log |
